language_approval.notes: Approved unchanged. All five mean very hot (Cambridge/M-W): scorching and sweltering = weather/heat, sweltering adds humid, oppressive; boiling/baking/roasting informal, weather or how a person feels. Phrases natural as fragments: (I am) boiling in this small room, a scorching summer day, the sweltering heat of the city, (it is) baking outside today, (I am) roasting in this sweater - sweater is US. Hook/CTA = L1 template. No caps in speech, TTS-safe. Text identical to the H11 twin unit.
